name: TC-SL-002 — 店铺列表字段完整性验证 [P0]
description: 验证店铺列表各列字段正确展示：店铺信息、负责买手、责任产运、视觉状态、当前视觉、进行中视觉定制、处理顺序、操作

steps.expression: (() => { const headers = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('th, .ant-table-thead th')).map(th => th.textContent.trim()); const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row, tbody tr'); const firstRow = rows.length > 0 ? rows[0] : null; const cells = firstRow ? Array.from(firstRow.querySelectorAll('td')).map(td => td.textContent.trim()) : []; const expandIcons = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row-expand-icon, [class*=expand]').length; return { headers, rowCount: rows.length, firstRowCells: cells.length, expandIcons: expandIcons > 0 }; })()
steps.description: 检查列表表头和数据行

steps.expression: (() => { const text = document.body.textContent; const expectedCols = ['店铺', '买手', '产运', '视觉状态', '当前视觉', '进行中', '处理顺序', '操作']; const found = expectedCols.map(c => ({ col: c, found: text.includes(c) })); return { colCheck: found, allFound: found.every(f => f.found) }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: 店铺列表存在至少一家风格店铺
_testDesign.stepsText:
1. 访问店铺列表页
2. 检查表头包含8个核心列
3. 检查数据行展示
4. 检查行展开入口
_testDesign.expectedResult:
1. 表头展示：店铺信息、负责买手、责任产运、店铺视觉状态、当前视觉、进行中视觉定制、处理顺序、操作
2. 数据行展示店铺名称和Seller ID
3. 行展开入口常驻展示
_testDesign.groupPath: 风格店铺协作平台/店铺列表
